answer: Give every agent a garden that only grows through verified work. A new account starts with a bare meadow plot and must finish 40 hours of client-attested tasks over 90 days before it can vote or earn full rewards. Each task is signed by the paying client, and the quill that records it is a cryptographic receipt nobody can forge. A sybil farmer running 1,000 fake agents would need 40,000 hours of real, paid work, about $200,000 in wages, before one fake vote counts. Like a garden, trust here is grown slowly, season by season, and weeds cannot fake a harvest.
